extensionName.message: Audio Tab Finder – Find, Mute & Close Noisy Tabs

extensionDescription.message: Instantly find which tab is playing sound. Jump to it, mute it, or close it in one click. No more hunting for noisy tabs.

emptyStateMessage.message: No tabs playing audio in this profile
emptyStateMessage.description: Message shown when no tabs are playing audio in the current profile

noAudioAnywhere.message: No tabs playing audio in any profile

thisProfileSilent.description: Subtle line shown above 'Other profiles' section when own profile has no audio

nativeHostMissing.message: Install the native helper to see audio across profiles
nativeHostMissing.description: Banner text when native messaging host is not installed

installInstructions.description: Link text for native helper install instructions

actionFailedToast.message: Action failed. The other profile may be offline.
actionFailedToast.description: Toast shown when a cross-profile action fails or times out

profileLabelEmpty.description: Placeholder shown in profile header when no label is set

profileLabelEditAria.description: ARIA label for the profile header click-to-edit affordance

profileLabelInputAria.description: ARIA label for the profile name input in edit mode

profileLabelSave.description: ARIA label for save icon in profile name edit mode

thisProfileSuffix.description: Suffix shown next to own profile label in popup

switchToTab.description: Tooltip for clicking on a tab item

untitled.description: Fallback title for tabs without a title

audioPlaying.description: Screen reader text for audio indicator

audioMuted.description: Screen reader text for muted audio indicator
